title: Adaptive auditing of AI systems with anytime-valid guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2605.07002v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A major bottleneck in characterizing the failure modes of generative AI systems is the cost and time of annotation and evaluation. Consequently, adaptive testing paradigms have gained popularity, where one opportunistically decides which cases and how many to annotate based on past results. While this framework is highly practical, its extreme flexibility makes it difficult to draw statistically rigorous conclusions, as it violates classical assumptions: the number of observations is typically limited (often 10 to 50 cases) and decisions regarding sampling and stopping are made in the midst of data collection rather than based a pre-specified rule. translated_title: 具有任意时有效保证的AI系统自适应审计
translated_abstract: 刻画生成式AI系统失效模式的一个主要瓶颈是标注和评估的成本与时间。因此，自适应测试范式日益流行：人们根据过往结果机会主义地决定标注哪些案例以及标注多少案例。虽然这一框架非常实用，但其极端灵活性使得难以得出统计学上严谨的结论，因为它违反了经典统计假设：观测数量通常有限（往往只有10到50个案例），且关于采样和停止的决策是在数据收集过程中临时做出的，而非基于预先指定的规则。为了刻画从高度自适应的审计中能够得出哪些统计推断，我们从两种“对峙”的视角引入了一个假设检验框架：(i) 模型的原假设，即断言不存在性能低于目标阈值的失效模式；与 (ii) 审计者……
tldr: 提出了一个具有任意时有效统计保证的假设检验框架，使高度自适应的AI系统审计——即使样本量小、采样与停止规则在过程中灵活决定——也能得出统计学上严谨的结论。
en_tdlr: Proposes a hypothesis testing framework with anytime-valid guarantees that enables statistically rigorous conclusions from highly adaptive AI system audits, even with small sample sizes and flexible sampling and stopping decisions made during data collection.
